name: Cat Ba food guide
summary: Seafood by weight is the meal on đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc. The 28 July 2025 special-zone list names nine foods. The 20 June 2013 posting is a price board. A current price is Check on arrival.
body: Come for the harbor meal, not a Ha Long menu. The 28 July 2025 list names cá song, bề bề, tu hài, ngao Phù Long, gà Liên Minh, mật ong rừng, cam Gia Luận, khoai sọ Hiền Hào, and nước mắm Cát Hải. The 8 January 2016 article says the island’s seafood is best in winter, before the spring spawn. Rượu mật ong and rượu hồng hoa are the drinks in that same sentence.

The 20 June 2013 district posting prints the seafood and a few prepared bowls. Those đồng figures are that day’s board. A current price is Check on arrival. Current doors are Check on arrival. The posting’s own warning: skip a place that does not post its prices, or that changes the posted price. Phở is a line at Trúc Hạnh on Núi Ngọc and at Phương Nhung, số 184 đường 1/4. No garnish and no broth are given. Bánh đa cua is a prepared line at that same Phương Nhung address. It is not on the special-zone list, and it is not a retelling of the Hải Phòng bowl.

Mật ong Cát Bà is the honey households sell. The 5 April 2013 account calls it dark yellow, thick, and fragrant. Nước mắm Cát Hải is made on đảo Cát Hải, the other island, and the honey account says a visitor on Cát Bà can buy it. Gà Liên Minh is not the same dish as gà nướng mật ong.
specialtiesLead: Nine names on the special-zone list, then every other animal and prepared line on the 20 June 2013 board.

sections.heading: City specialties
paragraphs: The nine special-zone names come first: cá song, bề bề, tu hài, ngao Phù Long, gà Liên Minh, mật ong rừng, cam Gia Luận, khoai sọ Hiền Hào, and nước mắm Cát Hải. The lines under them are the rest of the 20 June 2013 board, with size grades folded into the parent name. Phở and bánh đa cua are in the introduction. They are prepared bowls on that board, not a second recipe.

Where a cooking method is not in the name, none is given. Ngao hấp xả, gà nướng mật ong, cá thu kho một nắng, cháo ngao, and cháo cá carry the method in the name. Nước mắm Cát Hải is the sauce that is sunned. A current price on every line is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: The harbor streets
paragraphs: After the boat, eat on đường 1/4 in thị trấn Cát Bà, the street where the 20 June 2013 board places seafood by weight. A closing hour is Check on arrival. Đường Núi Ngọc is the other street, called phố ẩm thực on that posting. Some doors are printed in thị trấn Cát Bà. Thuyền Chài Quán is printed on phố ẩm thực, đường Núi Ngọc, thị trấn Cát Hải. Both wordings stay. Do not draw one street through both towns.

Bến Bèo is the quay kitchens on the same board, at tổ 11, thị trấn Cát Bà. The Cái Bèo account puts the quay area 1.5 km from the town center. The 15 March 2011 account says about 2 km by road. Both stay. An hour is Check on arrival.

Cổng chợ Cát Bà has two 2013 addresses. Phú Long is “Số 3 Tổ 14 - Cổng Chợ Cát Bà”, with no thị trấn on that line. Khánh Huyền is “Số 11, cổng chợ Cát Bà, thị trấn Cát Hải”. A market hall and a daytime hour are Check on arrival. The 8 January 2016 article sends people to a night market after dinner for sea souvenirs. The street is Check on arrival.

The 2013 board also places floating doors on vịnh Cảng Cá in thị trấn Cát Bà: Cát Tiên, Hưng Mạnh, San Hô Đỏ, Tuyến Béo, and Trang Nhung. From 10 November 2021 the city moved the fish-port logistics to cảng cá Trân Châu. The notice does not say these kitchens moved. Do not treat the 2013 port as the working harbor. Vịnh Cái Bèo has Quang Anh and Xuân Hồng on that board. This is the bay, not the archaeological coordinate.

The 24 July 2023 park article says chợ nổi vịnh Lan Hạ is smaller than a Mekong floating market and is mostly the fish-raft keepers. A visitor can buy seafood there as a gift. No stall name and no clock are given. Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Cat Ba food guide — seafood by weight on the harbor
seoDescription: Seafood by weight on 1/4 and Núi Ngọc, plus nine foods on the special-zone list. The 2013 board is a price list. A current price is Check on arrival.
